quiz.question_id: Bagaimana cara sebuah tipe mengimplementasikan interface di Go?
quiz.question_en: How does a type implement an interface in Go?
options_id: Secara implisit — dengan memiliki semua method yang didefinisikan dalam interface
Dengan mendaftarkan tipe ke interface secara eksplisit
options_en: Implicitly — by having all methods defined in the interface
By explicitly registering the type with the interface

quiz.question_id: Apa yang terjadi jika fungsi `printShapeInfo(s Shape)` dipanggil dengan nilai nil?
quiz.question_en: What happens if function `printShapeInfo(s Shape)` is called with a nil value?
options_id: Terjadi panic saat method dipanggil pada nil interface
options_en: Panic occurs when a method is called on a nil interface

quiz.question_id: Apa keuntungan implementasi interface yang implisit di Go dibanding Java?
quiz.question_en: What is the advantage of Go's implicit interface implementation compared to Java?
options_id: Tipe bisa memenuhi interface yang belum ada saat tipe tersebut dibuat (retroaktif)
options_en: A type can satisfy interfaces that didn't exist when the type was created (retroactive)
